summary: MCP is a standard between an AI app (the host) and the tools it uses, not a replacement for function calling. You write a tiny MCP server with one tool, start it from a client over stdio, list its tools and call one, and learn why a stdio server must never print to standard output.
goal: Run a tiny MCP server and list its tool.

items.text: Add the SDK, word_server.py and list_and_call.py and match the four lines
Add a second tool, shout, and predict what list_tools prints
Print a line in the server on purpose and write down what your version does
Call count_words with a number and read the error
Draw the six messages between the host, the model and the server
Play the MCP Check game to the end and see your score
